# SWEPT

> SWEPT is a Gold Coast owned and operated commercial property care provider serving the Gold Coast and South East Queensland. It offers six specialist services through one point of contact.

## Services

- [Commercial Sweeping (SWEPT)](%VITE_SITE_URL%/#sweeping): mechanical sweeping for car parks, warehouses, industrial sites, shopping centres, construction sites, body corporates and councils.
- [Commercial Floor Scrubbing (Scrubbed by Swept)](%VITE_SITE_URL%/#scrubbed): machine floor scrubbing for warehouses, industrial facilities, shopping centres and commercial hard floors.
- [Commercial Pressure Cleaning (Washed by Swept)](%VITE_SITE_URL%/#washed): pressure cleaning for car parks, footpaths, building exteriors, loading docks and bin bays.
- [Commercial Grounds Maintenance (Grounds by Swept)](%VITE_SITE_URL%/#grounds): lawn mowing, garden maintenance, hedge trimming, weed management and scheduled grounds upkeep.
- [Commercial Cleaning (Cleaned by Swept)](%VITE_SITE_URL%/#cleaned): office, warehouse, retail, strata common area and amenities cleaning.
- [Commercial Line Marking (Marked by Swept)](%VITE_SITE_URL%/#marked): car park line marking, parking bays, warehouse safety lines, pedestrian walkways and directional arrows.

## Service area

Gold Coast, Brisbane, Logan, Ipswich, Redlands, Moreton Bay and Northern NSW.
